name: tesota
description: An open-source, verification-first agent for work that carries its evidence

scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:run
scripts.test:run: vitest run tests --exclude tests/workspace-checkout.test.ts --exclude tests/workspace.test.ts --exclude tests/workspace-prune.test.ts --exclude tests/workspace-update.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=10000 && vitest run tests/workspace-checkout.test.ts tests/workspace.test.ts tests/workspace-prune.test.ts tests/workspace-update.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=20000
scripts.formal:check: lsc check --backend=dafny src/verification/finding-origin-rule.ts && lsc check --backend=dafny src/verification/review-estimate.ts && lsc check --backend=dafny src/verification/explorer-answer.ts && lsc check --backend=dafny src/verification/turn-time-limit.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint
